The '''Ualaq''' were an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] hailing from the planet [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. They preferred living on land instead of in the [[Water/Legends|water]]. Unlike the Quara and the Aquala, who had two eyes, the less-common Ualaq had four.<ref name="CSWE" />
